name: enable_bitmapscan
description: Controls whether the query planner considers bitmap index scan plans during query plan generation.
symptoms: Suboptimal query plans for selective index queries
Increased sequential scan usage on large tables
Higher I/O and slower query execution for multi-index conditions
Missed opportunities for efficient OR/IN clause evaluation
tuning_tips: Leave enabled unless profiling shows bitmap scans consistently underperforming index or sequential scans for your workload; disable only selectively after plan analysis with EXPLAIN.
